This land no be my own, na rent I dey rent am. My husband and me, we dey try feed the children with this small maize. I no get plenty money for fertilizer this year — the harvest last year no plenty because rain come late. I go put small manure from our goats and the chicken, and I go buy small fertilizer if the agent bring am to our village, but I no fit buy plenty because the plot no big and one bag too much for me alone. I go use the seed I keep from last year like my mother teach me — improved seed dey cost and I no sure if e go do well for rented land.
